## 🇩🇪 German — Daily Phrases (3)
1. **Ich lasse mich davon inspirieren** — [ikh LAH-suh mikh dah-FON in-shpee-REE-ren] — *I let myself be inspired by it*
2. **Das klingt vielversprechend** — [dahs klingt FEEL-fair-shpreh-khent] — *That sounds promising*
3. **Mir fällt gerade ein...** — [meer felt geh-RAH-duh ine] — *It just occurs to me... / I just thought of...*
